title_working: In This Town, Every Kid Gets A Floating Defense Number
world_rule: In This Town, Every Kid Gets A Floating Defense Number

lines.text: In this town, every kid gets a floating number showing how many pounds of force they can reflect, so why was Mason stuck at zero?
lines.say: (serious) In this town, every kid gets a floating number showing how many pounds of force they can reflect, so why was Mason stuck at zero?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Mason wore heavy rubber boots every day, but his classmates teased him whenever he stumbled during gym class.
lines.say: (sad) Mason wore heavy rubber boots every day, but his classmates teased him whenever he stumbled during gym class.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So everyone laughed and called him useless, while Marcus bragged about his massive score of nine hundred.
lines.say: (angry) So everyone laughed and called him useless, while Marcus bragged about his massive score of nine hundred.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But during afternoon recess, the sky suddenly turned deep purple as a rogue magnetic storm hit the playground.
lines.say: (worried) But during afternoon recess, the sky suddenly turned deep purple as a rogue magnetic storm hit the playground.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So the high defense numbers began attracting heavy metal debris from across the city straight toward the crowd.
lines.say: (nervous) So the high defense numbers began attracting heavy metal debris from across the city straight toward the crowd.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus tried to run, but his nine hundred score magnetised a giant steel beam and pinned him to the ground.
lines.say: (worried) Marcus tried to run, but his nine hundred score magnetised a giant steel beam and pinned him to the ground.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So Mason charged into the electrical wind, completely unfazed by the pull.
lines.say: (confident) So Mason charged into the electrical wind, completely unfazed by the pull.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The truth was that Mason's zero score was not weakness, but absolute zero magnetic charge.
lines.say: (serious) The truth was that Mason's zero score was not weakness, but absolute zero magnetic charge.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: His heavy rubber boots had kept his body grounded, allowing him to lift the steel beam safely off Marcus.
lines.say: (confident) His heavy rubber boots had kept his body grounded, allowing him to lift the steel beam safely off Marcus.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So the zero rating was actually an emergency bypass created to save the town when shields went wild.
lines.say: (happy) So the zero rating was actually an emergency bypass created to save the town when shields went wild.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus hugged Mason in tears, while the whole school cheered for the kid they once mocked.
lines.say: (happy) Marcus hugged Mason in tears, while the whole school cheered for the kid they once mocked.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And now nobody chuckles when they ask why Mason was stuck at zero.
lines.say: (soft tone) And now nobody chuckles when they ask why Mason was stuck at zero.
lines.speaker: narrator
